product_brief: A post-quantum KMIP 3.0 key-management server built on softhsmrustv3 with a CACP crypto-agility policy engine.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and hybrid KEMs (X25519MLKEM768, SecP256r1MLKEM768). Implements a "quantum-safe" TLS profile enforcing hybrid ECDHE-ML-KEM key agreement. Built on softhsmrustv3 engine with durable or in-memory key stores.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, AES, HMAC, X25519, SecP256r1, SecP384r1, SHA-256, SHA-384, ChaCha20-Poly1305
key_management_model: Three-plane architecture (policy / KMIP / PKCS#11); durable SQLite or volatile in-memory key store; admin-mTLS for control plane; TLS for data plane.
architecture_type: Server-based (SaaS/On-prem capable via binary); three-plane architecture (policy, KMIP, PKCS#11); agentless client interaction via KMIP protocol.
primary_platforms: Linux (implied by Rust/Cargo build), WebAssembly (in-browser control plane)
testing_&_validation_methods: Rust integration suite, OASIS KMIP 3.0 replay harness, Known-answer-test (KAT) vectors, hybrid KEM end-to-end tests, TLS e2e tests.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports sandbox (in-memory) and production (SQLite) deployments; provides demo scripts and policy engines for migration testing.
